interface_relation.agenticsim: Use active repair to adjust placement or task constraints after AgenticSim/RoboTwin feasibility failures.

sources.name: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
sources.input: Real-robot task, policy, environment reset capability, rollout feedback, and an agent-generated research iteration.
sources.output: Repeated reset, execute, verify, and policy-refinement cycles with physical autoresearch metrics.

evidence: Official project and arXiv paper verified on 2026-07-13.
No code link is exposed by the official project page.

interface_relation.agenticsim: AgenticSim can provide a simulator-side counterpart to the environment loop before real-robot deployment.
